cohort: The cohort consisted of 174,829 adult patients (>=18 years) hospitalized in 87 German Helios hospitals with a primary discharge diagnosis of heart failure between January 2016 and August 2022.
finding: Co-morbid Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) was present in over half of hospitalized heart failure patients and was independently associated with increased in-hospital mortality and higher rehospitalization rates.
